observer.coordinate_provenance: Published camera location with six-decimal WGS84 coordinates on the Wikimedia Commons record; transformed to EPSG:27700 with PROJ/pyproj, not independently surveyed

target.name: Tryfan summit reference
target.provenance: Canonical Meridian Tryfan summit reference; photograph title/subject supports this target, but the exact optical aim point is INFERRED

camera_calibration.derivation: Full-frame-equivalent rectilinear FOV: 2*atan(36 mm/(2*230 mm)); vertical uses 24 mm. The image is 3:2.
camera_calibration.uncertainty: Editing/cropping and lens distortion are not independently known. Treat 8.9498 degrees as the documented initial calibration, not a surveyed FOV.

uncertainties: The published camera coordinate is precise but has not been independently ground-surveyed.
The exact optical aim point and camera roll are not present in EXIF; summit targeting is inferred from the photograph subject.
FOV is derived from the EXIF 230 mm 35 mm equivalent and assumes the published 3:2 image retains the full captured frame.
DTM is the geometry benchmark surface; DSM is retained to quantify vegetation/structure differences but is not the default Unreal Landscape.

derived_terrain_expectations.surface: DTM R16, bilinear at BNG coordinate

preservation_note: Preserved from the original Lab 004 preparation. Its precise viewpoint and lens metadata remain useful provenance, but its inferred optical target made it unsuitable as the primary geometric-registration benchmark.
